findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed the water inlet from the bun steamer on the cook like to be dripping. Ensure all food equipment is maintained in good repair. Correct by next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. [C]

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed personal cell phones on the barista counter as well as on the shelving above the cook line. Personal items must be stored away from areas of food preparation. Cease this practice.
findings.citation_text: 6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination. [C]

findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.comment: An employee was observed handling fries from above with bare hands in away that bare hands will come in contact with fries (ready-to-eat food). CORRECTED- Discussed with PIC, who provided education to staff. Use gloves to prevent bare hand contact with RTE foods. Ref. 3-301.11 [P]

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control.
findings.comment: Foods in the 2 door freezer on the cookline (near the office) were observed soft to the touch. Freezer thermometer read 37F. Foods were moved to the walk-in freezer. The freezer was pulled away from the wall to promote air flow. PIC will monitor the cooler and order repairs as needed. Foods will not be stored in the freezer until it is able to maintain them frozen. Ref. 3-501.11 [C]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: Duct tape was observed used to repair a support in the top of the make line cold well. Replace the damaged piece or make repairs that are smooth and easily cleanable. Duct tape is not an appropriate material. Ref. 4-101.11 [C]
